Streamlined **iris-interop-dev** MCP server (interop-focused fork of iris-agentic-dev).

| platform | asset |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `iris-interop-dev-macos-arm64` |
| macOS, Intel | `iris-interop-dev-macos-x64` |
| Linux x64 | `iris-interop-dev-linux-x64` |
| Linux x64, older glibc (AL2023, RHEL 8-9, Debian 12) | `iris-interop-dev-linux-x64-musl` |
| Linux arm64 (Graviton, arm64 runners, arm64 Docker VMs) | `iris-interop-dev-linux-arm64` |
| Linux arm64, older glibc | `iris-interop-dev-linux-arm64-musl` |
| Windows x64 | `iris-interop-dev-windows-x64.exe` |

**Workshop VM (Windows):** download `iris-interop-dev-windows-x64.exe`, place it at
`C:\iris-interop-dev\iris-interop-dev.exe`, then register the MCP:
```
claude mcp add --scope user iris-interop-dev --env IRIS_HOST=localhost --env IRIS_WEB_PORT=80 --env IRIS_WEB_PREFIX=irishealth --env IRIS_USERNAME=_SYSTEM --env IRIS_PASSWORD=SYS --env IRIS_NAMESPACE=USER -- C:/iris-interop-dev/iris-interop-dev.exe mcp
```
Tool names are identical to iris-agentic-dev, so the iris-interop-skills work unchanged.


## What's Changed
* feat(iris_global): read globals in the routines profile — subscripts, $DATA and bounded walks (#532) by @PYDuquesnoy in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/550
* feat(iris_global): write one node, and refuse the globals IRIS owns (#532) by @PYDuquesnoy in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/552
* feat(global): delete a global only through the preview that showed it (#532) by @PYDuquesnoy in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/554
* chore(deps): bump tokio from 1.53.1 to 1.53.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/544
* chore(deps): bump which from 8.0.5 to 8.0.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/545
* chore(deps): bump schemars from 1.2.1 to 1.2.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/547
* chore(deps): bump uuid from 1.26.0 to 1.28.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/548
* chore(deps): bump rmcp 1.6 to 3.8, pinning the wire shape it keeps by @PYDuquesnoy in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/560
* feat(release): publish Linux arm64, and refuse a wrong-arch download instead of verifying it by @PYDuquesnoy in https://github.com/intersystems-ib/iris-interop-dev/pull/561
* fix(hook): bound post-edit compiles to the project
